title: Hi! My name is Isabel!
text: I am an Engineering Physics student at UBC focusing on Electrical Engineering and Math. I have experience building electrical systems, PCBA design and verification, and electromechanical integration, not to mention a healthy side of firmware and software. I love working in a fast paced environment with quick iterative design where I get to go through the whole idea to prototype to validation cycle. Check out the Portfolio page for more details on some cool technical projects and the Fun page for a bit more about me outside of engineering. Hope you have some fun looking around!
